name: Pluto Personal — Strategist + Vault Scratch
description: Pluto's actual personal workflow: Claude Code at the user-home level acting as 'Strategist Claude' over an Obsidian-based second-brain vault, paired with a vault-root scratch shell for grep/git/file ops. Demonstrates the dual-Claude pattern (Strategist in this app + Claudian inside Obsidian). REQUIRES adaptation: the cwd paths are Pluto's machine. To use it as a template, edit the cwd values to your own home dir + your own second-brain vault path before loading. If you don't have a second-brain vault, this pack will spawn shells in directories that don't exist on your machine — load `claude-code-basic.deck.json` instead.

tabs.label: Strategist Claude
startCommands: echo 'STRATEGIST: edit cwd to your own home dir before loading. Pluto reads pluto-mind/CLAUDE.md, hot.md, GOALS.md, patterns.md on first request.'
tabs.system_prompt_hint: Strategist Claude per the user's own second-brain CLAUDE.md (if it exists). Read meta files first before responding to anything substantive. Be blunt and direct. Surface patterns by name.

tabs.label: Vault scratch
startCommands: echo 'VAULT: edit cwd to your own vault path. Use this for grep, ls, file moves, git, etc.'

env_hints.purpose: Required for the strategist pane. If saved on welcome screen, auto-injected.

notes: ADAPT BEFORE LOADING: change C:\Users\pluto to YOUR home dir, change C:\Users\pluto\Documents\pluto-mind to YOUR second-brain vault path.
Pluto's full second-brain reference layout (pluto-mind) is documented separately. If you don't have one yet, watch Pluto's video on building one or use claude-code-basic.deck.json instead.
On Mac/Linux: paths look like /Users/<you>/Documents/myvault or /home/<you>/notes — adjust accordingly.
